Account: J. Doe, AP Analyst, Finance, manager r.iyer@example.com, not privileged, MFA NOT enrolled, usual hours 03:30-12:30 UTC, usual IPs 198.51.100.10 and 198.51.100.22. The 02:58 start is ~30 min before usual hours and source IP is not a usual IP.

Account-scoped window (02:58:05Z-03:13:51Z) contains exactly 51 events for j.doe@example.com, all from 203.0.113.45 to WS-FIN-014: 50 auth_failure with reason bad_password on a strictly regular ~19s cadence (02:58:05 ... 03:13:36), then one auth_success at 03:13:51Z with method=password and mfa=not_enrolled. All 51 events carry user_agent 'python-requests/2.31' — scripted, not a browser/Outlook client. No throttling/lockout observed across 50 failures.

IP-scoped window shows the same IP hit three accounts: 70 auth_failures + 1 auth_success across j.doe@example.com/WS-FIN-014 (51), a.kumar@example.com/WS-FIN-009 (12) and m.lee@example.com/WS-HR-003 (8), interleaved in the same time range with the same python-requests user agent. Only j.doe@example.com succeeded. This is multi-account password spraying alongside targeted brute force, not a single-account issue.

30-day look-back (2026-10-24T03:13:51Z-2026-11-23T03:13:51Z) for j.doe@example.com from 203.0.113.45 returns only the 51 events of this same window (first ts 02:58:05Z). Confirms the IP is genuinely unfamiliar for this account; no prior history inside the look-back.

MOCK intel for 203.0.113.45 verdict=malicious, score 87, tags credential-stuffing and password-spray, AS64500, country ZZ, 23 reports, first seen 2026-10-02, last seen 2026-11-23. Note the file itself classifies the address as an RFC 5737 documentation range, i.e. synthetic data — this is not live reputational intelligence and must not drive blocking on its own.

Host-scoped WS-FIN-014 through 04:13:51Z shows post-login actions from the same IP 203.0.113.45 and account: mailbox_rule_created at 03:17:03Z (action forward_all to ext.billing-update@example.org, rule name '..'), file_access at 03:21:31Z (14 files, 8,421,377 bytes read from share \\fs-fin-01\payables), and logout at 03:24:53Z. A ~3-minute session from login to logout that created an external mail-forwarding rule and bulk-read payables data — no other account or process events on the host in the window.
